svg.title: How SpendInCheck is put together
svg.desc: Client: React app (TypeScript and Vite, split per route and served from the edge.) Then: API: Flask, /api/v1 (One module per resource. Routes present data and hold no SQL.) Then: Operations: server/operations (Every SQL query as one function, parameterised and scoped to the signed-in user.) Then: Data: PostgreSQL (Ledger, budgets, holdings and daily closing prices.); Scheduled jobs (Closing prices, recurring entries and demo clean-up. Each is safe to run twice.)
